Bjorklund.e: Borrowed from Swedish Björklund, from björk (“birch tree”) + lund (“grove”).

Bjorkman.e: Borrowed from Swedish Björkman, an ornamental surname composed of the elements björk (“birch”) and man (“man”).

Bjorge.e: Borrowed from Norwegian Bjørge. Further from Proto-Germanic *bergō, from *berganą. Ultimately from Proto-Indo-European *bʰergʰ- (whence also borrow, bury).
